name: avert-mcp

tools.name: index_repo
tools.description: Index (or re-index) a repository: routes, functions, call chains and every external API call site.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: sync_changes
tools.description: Pull provider changes for the SDKs this repo uses (SDK release diffs + model lifecycle data) and create findings.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: list_changes
tools.description: List provider change events that touch this repo (removed, renamed, deprecated, retired, added). Added = notice only.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

provider.description: Provider id: openai, anthropic, stripe, gemini, twilio

tools.name: blast_radius
tools.description: Everything one change breaks: call sites (down the API surface, through rolling aliases), then routes and owner teams (up the call chain), each with its path.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: Findings (one per change x call site) with status open | claimed | done | declined.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: explain_path
tools.description: The evidence path for one finding: change -> surface -> call site -> functions -> route -> owner, with file and line.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: rank_findings
tools.description: Rank findings by severity, urgency (days to effective date) and reach (routes + PageRank centrality of the call chain).

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: migration_batches
tools.description: Group findings into migration batches: connected components (WCC) of findings sharing an owner and a change or function. One batch = one issue.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: claim_finding
tools.description: Atomically claim an open finding so no other agent works on it. Fails if already claimed, naming the holder.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: record_decision
tools.description: Remember a decision about a finding (fix, defer, wontfix, accept_risk, note) so later sessions and other agents see it.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Recall memory: decisions and sessions (episodic) and migration recipes (procedural, from this repo and the shared graph). With no ids, returns recent history. Call this first.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: sdk_params
tools.description: Params of a finding's operation in the provider's latest SDK, with doc text and deprecation flags. Use it to choose a replacement when a change names none.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: save_recipe
tools.description: Save how a change was fixed (from -> to: a param name or literal value, with steps) so the next matching migration reuses it.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: publish_recipe
tools.description: Publish a repo recipe to the shared graph so other repositories hit by the same change are offered it.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: open_issue
tools.description: Open one GitHub issue for a migration batch, with every path as evidence.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

tools.name: open_pr
tools.description: Open a GitHub pull request fixing one finding, when the change names a replacement or a recipe covers it. Never merges.

repo.description: Repository: local path or GitHub URL. Defaults to AVERT_REPO or the working directory.

instructions: Avert knows every external API call in this repository and which provider changes reach them. Start with `recall` to see earlier decisions and sessions, then `rank_findings` or `list_changes`. Use `blast_radius` / `explain_path` to show evidence, and `record_decision` to remember what was decided.
